model.calibration: Authored fictional game balance; not empirical weapon ownership rates or canon power scale. Editable parameters.
model.defaultWithinTier: Equal base per eligible item within each tier before explicit lore factors.
model.factorCombination: Within one profile use maximum matching tag factor once, not product of overlapping tags. Composite race log factors average. Different actual role and Backstory sources add tempered log likelihoods, then cap total item factor100.

affinityAnchors.scope: 55% of eligible Tier4 mass; typical Human Paladin about10.1% of the entire wheel, depending on None. Five tier masses remain equal.
affinityAnchors.suppressedBy: Equalizer or hard weapon exclusion; never restore forbidden items.

model.tierPolicy: Latest direct user: each weapon Tier has equal probability. None is outside the five tiers; each tier receives20% of non-None probability. Lore changes item odds within each tier, never total tier mass.
